summary: Re-tested the live admin browser flow and backend regression suite. Complete event creation, persistence, field validation, edit, delete, login, responsive workspace loading, and cookie-backed session restoration passed.
action_items: Consider adding an explicit loading state while /api/auth/me resolves to avoid any transient login screen during admin reload.
Clean up the existing Discovery useEffect exhaustive-deps warnings when convenient.
seed_data_creation: Created, edited, and deleted TEST_UI_Complete_Event_Atlas through the browser flow; verified no matching test event remained. No persistent seed data remains from this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin create/edit/delete and validation flows are covered against the public URL. Short description produced a field-specific description message; malformed organizer email was blocked by native email validation. Console output contained only expected initial unauthenticated /api/auth/me 401 responses and expected invalid-submit 422 response, with no uncaught application errors.
rca of the issue: The reported generic save error is resolved in the tested flow: trimmed form payload values satisfy the API, and formatError maps FastAPI validation arrays to field-specific toast text. Complete payload POST returned success and the row persisted after reload.
